g.title: pappus_blocks
g.text: 360 vertices: four subdivided Pappus graphs joined by 72 connectors on a tetrahedron

g.title: titleB
g.text: one block: the Pappus graph with every edge subdivided twice

g.title: legend
g.text: the two dots on every edge are its ports

g.title: titleK
g.text: the four blocks and the four connector classes

g.title: faceTag
g.text: a face is a class of 18 connectors, named by the block it misses;
every edge carries the 36 connectors of its two faces
